title: Extremum Seeking Control
text: Compute controller parameters in real time by maximizing objective function, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Forcing frequency omega (rad/s)} sets Forcing frequency; {Time Domain} sets the filter and integrator time domain Continuous, {Sample time} sets the discrete-time filter and integrator sample, {Integrator method} sets the discrete-time integration method Forward, {Number of parameters}, {Initial condition x0} sets the initial parameter values, {Learning rate k} sets the parameter update rate, {Demodulation amplitude a} sets the demodulation signal amplitude, {Demodulation phase phi_1 (rad)} sets the demodulation signal phase, {Modulation amplitude b} sets the modulation signal amplitude, {Modulation phase phi_2 (rad)} sets the modulation signal phase, {Enable HPF} enables high-pass filtering of objective function, {HPF frequency omega_h (rad/s)} sets the high-pass filter cutoff frequency, {Enable LPF} enables low-pass filtering of demodulated, {LPF frequency omega_l (rad/s)} sets the low-pass filter cutoff frequency ω l and {Output estimated parameters} adds estimated parameters output port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Time Domain
params.values: Filter and integrator time domain Continuous time (default) | Discrete time

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Discrete-time filter and integrator sample time 0.1 (default) | finite positive scalar

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: Discrete-time integration method Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Number of parameters
params.values: Number of parameters 1 (default) | positive integer less than or equal to 5

params.name: Initial condition x0
params.values: Initial parameter values 0 (default) | finite scalar | vector

params.name: Forcing frequency omega (rad/s)
params.values: Forcing frequency 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Learning rate k
params.values: Parameter update rate 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Demodulation amplitude a
params.values: Demodulation signal amplitude 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Demodulation phase phi_1 (rad)
params.values: Demodulation signal phase 0 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Modulation amplitude b
params.values: Modulation signal amplitude 0.1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Modulation phase phi_2 (rad)
params.values: Modulation signal phase 0 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Enable HPF
params.values: Enable high-pass filtering of objective function signal off (default) | on

params.name: HPF frequency omega_h (rad/s)
params.values: High-pass filter cutoff frequency 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Enable LPF
params.values: Enable low-pass filtering of demodulated signal off (default) | on

params.name: LPF frequency omega_l (rad/s)
params.values: Low-pass filter cutoff frequency ω l 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Output estimated parameters
params.values: Add estimated parameters output port off (default) | on
